newsitem.title: JAPAN: G7 to act against wild dlr moves - monetary source.
newsitem.headline: G7 to act against wild dlr moves - monetary source.

text.p: Japan and the other members of the Group of Seven (G7) industrialised nations will take proper steps against excessive moves in foreign exchange rates following an agreement last weekend to seek currency stability, an international monetary source said on Thursday.
"Japan and other countries will take proper and timely steps in currency markets if they judge that moves in exchange rates are excessive," he told Reuters.
G7 finance ministers called for currency stability during their meeting on Saturday, saying their currencies were no longer greatly misaligned.
The G7 groups Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United States.
